parts:

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: moderated moderation model
parts: Maybe this is because of the due to the low N?

Maybe.  Low-N means a lot of sampling error, so if you explain a lot of variance in the outcome (thus, its residual variance is near zero), then it can be negative in some samples.  You can test whether those negative estimates are consistent with sampling error by looking at their 95% CIs.

https://groups.google.com/d/msg/lavaan/ESg_N66yYw8/p84RbJApCgAJ
Is this the right way to do calculate my SEM model?

messages.subject: Re: moderated moderation model
parts: Do You mean I should run a multiple regression for each EF factor?

There is only one EF common-factor, with 3 indicators.  Your question seemed to imply that you want to know the effects of each of the 3 indicators on the outcomes.  So I suggested you use them as predictors rather than extracting a common factor.
